aiResearchSummary.text: Verofax Limited is researching systems and methods for personalized retail with smart glasses, enabling buyers to view product information and make purchases through visual augmentation technology. Additionally, they are developing solutions for detecting purchased or tampered containers, allowing tracking of a product’s container state using cameras. These areas of research focus on enhancing traceability for products, stakeholders, and transactions.
